recipe.visualDefinition: A group portrait of four young men in casual dark clothing, arranged in a tiered composition on and around a brown leather sofa against a textured, concrete-like wall. The lighting is harsh, direct flash, creating high contrast and deep shadows, paired with distressed, stenciled typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Tiered human subjects against a flat, textured background
High-contrast flash lighting against desaturated earth tones
Distressed, large-scale typography framing the top and bottom of the frame
coreInvariants: Desaturated color palette dominated by browns, blacks, and grays

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged in a diamond-like formation; one at the top center, two in the middle, and one at the bottom center, filling the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central subjects' faces and the large, distressed white title at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top text, moves down through the central figures, and rests on the bottom text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily occupied by the textured wall behind the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted browns and grays (background and furniture)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the dark clothing and the bright flash-lit skin and text.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and grayscale

letterConstructionRules: Varying opacity within glyphs to simulate wear
Thick, blocky proportions with minimal kerning
characterSpecificRedesigns: Rounded, organic terminals on top text
Hard, industrial stencil edges on bottom text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, painted top text and rigid, industrial bottom text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the hand-painted look of the top text

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Impact or DIN with grunge overlay
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the blocky, condensed feel of the bottom text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A group of four young men in dark casual clothes sitting on a brown leather sofa in a room with a concrete wall. Lighting is harsh direct flash, creating sharp shadows. Desaturated color palette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, distressed white uppercase text at the top with a painted texture. Apply condensed, blocky white uppercase text at the bottom right with a subtle stencil effect.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting harsh and direct?
Is the text distressed and white?
Are the subjects arranged in a tiered formation?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not look like a standard clean font
Check that flash shadows are consistent across subjects
Verify the background texture is visible through the top text
Confirm the bottom text is legible against the dark clothing
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Tiered Group Portrait] + [Direct Flash Lighting] + [Industrial Texture] + [Distressed Block Typography] for an indie-rock aesthetic.
